question: Should stuck-session recovery keep current main's `run_stalled` result with immediate reply ownership release, or replace it with the PR's dedicated `aborted_for_stuck_recovery` result and timed settlement?
rationale: Both implementations are coherent, but they assign different terminal states and cleanup timing to the same operation; current main intentionally added the `run_stalled`-before-cancel ordering after this PR's merge base.

options.title: Keep current stale-expiry semantics
options.body: Rebase the phase classifier while retaining `run_stalled` and immediate forced release as the canonical reply-run recovery contract.

options.title: Adopt dedicated stuck-abort semantics
options.body: Use `aborted_for_stuck_recovery` and timed settlement only if maintainers intentionally want to replace the newer terminal-state contract.

recommendation.title: Keep current stale-expiry semantics
recommendation.body: Rebase the phase classifier while retaining `run_stalled` and immediate forced release as the canonical reply-run recovery contract.
